== The Druid Faction ==
[[File:Druid champion trophy.png|left|Druid Champion Trophy]]
[[File:Halls_Of_Balance.png|right|Halls of Balance]]
'''The Druids''' are part of the Neutral Factions that was implemented during the [[Updates#1.1 The Ancient Races|Ancient Races]] expansion. They feature a powerful [[Heritage]] that increases maximum [[mana]], and their final Challenge reward extends their spell to affect more buildings, and can even be made to affect all buildings!
* '''[[Alignment]]''': '''''Neutral'''''
* '''[[Alignment#Leges|Leges]]''': '''''Balance'''''
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]''': '''''Grand Balance''''' - Increase the production of your least productive building based on the amount of the three most built ones for 20 seconds.<br />{{Formula|naked|round \left(0.25 \times \left(\frac{xyz}{729}\right) ^{0.9}\right)|where x, y, and z are the number of your three most-built buildings.}}
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]''': '''''Halls of Balance''''' - Increases ''Grand Balance'' duration to 24 seconds and lower its cost by 200 mana.  
** Unlock requirement: Have ''Grand Balance'' affect Hall of Legends.  
* '''[[Heritage]]''':  Increase maximum Mana by 1 every 15 buildings you own.
* '''[[Bloodline]]''': Increase mana regeneration based on maximum mana.<br />{{Formula|0.03 \times x^{0.9}|your maximum mana (non-linear value)}}  
* '''[[Challenge|Challenge Reward]]''': '''''Primal Balance''''' - Grand Balance now affects extra buildings based on total mana spent, starting from the least to most productive building. To affect all 11 building tiers, you will need 10B mana produced (total).<br />{{Formula|naked|\left(0.1 \times x^{0.2}\right)^{1-\frac{A}{8} }|where x is mana produced and A is Ascension (Total) stat}}<br />{{PrimalB}}
* '''[[Unique Buildings|Research Building]]''': '''Stonehenge Circle''' (from Stone Pillars)
* '''[[Research|Research Facilities]]''':  '''''Economics, Alchemy'''''
* '''[[Buildings#Leges Unique Buildings|Leges Building]]''':  '''''Ziggurats''''' (from Ancient Pyramids)
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': See [[Druid#Unlock Requirements|below]]

== Unlock Requirements ==
To affiliate with a Neutral Faction, like for Vanilla Factions, you first need to choose the alignment. The alignment upgrade for Neutral Factions is called the '''[[Alignments|Proof of Neutrality]]'''. It will automatically appear in your next run, once all the 3 Faction quest items have been collected.<br />These requirements can be done in different game plays.

== Unique Building ==
[[File:Druid_Unique_Building_Design.png|thumb|left]] 
[[File:SCbuilding.png|right|190x190px]]
[[File:Ziggurat.png|right]]
At R22, Druid's ''Stone Pillars'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Stonehenge Circles,''''' which is required for some [[challenges]] and [[research]] quests. 

At R100, the Druid's ''Ancient Pyramids'' can be upgraded to a Unique Building: '''''Ziggurat''''', which when bought will grant access to the [[Faction Union]] upgrade.{{Clr}}

== Druid Research ==
[[File:Neutral-research-unlock.png|right|250px]]
Upon reaching R23, the game advisor tells us we have unearthed some ruins of the Ancient Races which might enable us to discover their research technology. The requirements can be done in different game plays.

To gain access to Druid [[research]], you will need the "Secrets of the Ancients" upgrade. This upgrade will appear when you have both the Neutral Unique building and the Key to the Lost city artifact. The Key to the Lost city can be [[Excavate|excavated]] in a separate run, and with any faction.
